subject: AmpliHealth VPC commercial — anchoring, ops credits and SLA ladder
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Beaumont <claire@amplihealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial VPC commercial and package options (pilot + support tiers)

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great to see how AmpliHealth plans to use the streaming chat and private embeddings. Per our discussion, attaching a high-level commercial with three paths: Pilot (6 mo), Production (annual commit), and Dedicated (multi-site). Key highlights:

- Platform fee: one-time onboarding + annual platform fee (options to amortize over 12 or 24 months).
- Operator licenses: seat-based vs node-based; we included an operator-seat mapping for your SRE team.
- Support tiers: Standard (8x5), Priority (24x7 on-call retainer), and Premier (SRE co-source).
- Migration credit: we can offer a conditional one-time credit tied to a 12-month commit — details / thresholds in the attached.

Attachment: AmpliHealth_VPC_Pricing_v1.pdf (pricing summary + assumptions)

If procurement needs a PO path or an amortization schedule we can produce a worksheet. Do you want me to loop in finance/legal now or keep this between sales/ops?

Next step: if this looks directionally correct I can prepare two clear alternatives: (A) lower platform fee + 18% discount first year + migration credit, or (B) amortized platform fee + reduced on-call retainer. Which would you prefer to review?

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Claire Beaumont <claire@amplihealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@amplihealth.com
Date: 2026-07-02T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial VPC commercial and package options (pilot + support tiers)

Hi Ben — thanks for the packet. A few immediate questions so procurement has what they need: 

1) Can you break the platform fee out vs the SOW? Procurement prefers platform fee as a separate line with amortization examples.
2) We need an explicit SLA credit table (for missed SLOs) tied to the Priority and Premier tiers — does Redwood have standard language?
3) Migration credit: curious on the trigger mechanism and whether it is refundable if we don’t hit commit thresholds.

CC'ing procurement — they will lead timelines once we have a clearer invoice and PO-ready doc.

Appreciate quick clarity — we are targeting a July procurement decision window.

Thanks,
Claire Beaumont
VP Product, AmpliHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AmpliHealth packet — proposed compromise for procurement

Looping in a suggested compromise for procurement's PO view:

- Offer A (anchor): Reduce upfront platform fee by 25% if customer signs 12-month commit; provide migration credit $75,000 applied as invoice credit within first 90 days.
- Offer B (amortize): Keep platform fee at list but amortize over 24 months on the invoice; provide 10% discount on first-year support retainer.
- SLA credits: Standard table (0.5% invoice credit per missed monthly SLO up to 5% cap) for Priority; Premier includes 1% cap plus SRE remediation hours.

Notes: Procurement often wants a PO-ready PDF and a one-page amortization table that finance can drop into their AP system — I added the workbook link into Related Links. If they ask about legal redlines, we shouldn't give credits that are refundable — make them conditional and tied to commit to avoid revenue churn.

Happy to draft a short email that frames the two options and recommended route (Offer A) if Ben wants to send it externally.

Marissa
Director, Commercial Strategy
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Beaumont <claire@amplihealth.com>
Cc: procurement@amplihealth.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-03T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Clear options and PO-ready attachments

Claire / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached are two PO-ready summaries (short PDF and spreadsheet) and the SLA credit table. High level:

Option 1 — Starter Anchor (recommended)
- One-time platform fee (reduced 25% with 12-mo commit)
- Migration credit: $75,000 applied as invoice credit within 90 days of signed SOW; not refundable if commit not met.
- Priority support retainer: $20k/mo (first year 15% discount)
- SLA: 0.5% invoice credit per missed monthly SLO up to 5% cap.

Option 2 — Amortized Path
- Platform fee amortized 24 months on invoice; no upfront reduction
- Migration credit: $50k conditional
- Support: 10% off first-year retainer

Doc links: https://redwood-internal.share/AMP-VPC-PO-worksheet (amortization workbook), DocuSign placeholder link below for SOW when ready.

If procurement can send example PO fields (billing address, tax id, purchase order workflows) I’ll push a PO-ready packet this week.

Ben
From: procurement@amplihealth.com
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Beaumont <claire@amplihealth.com>, legal@amplihealth.com
Date: 2026-07-05T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clear options and PO-ready attachments

Ben — appreciate the options. A couple procurement asks before we proceed to PO: 

- We need a vendor W9 and Redwood's EIN/tax details included on the packet.
- Please confirm that the migration credit is applied as invoice credit and that it will survive a change of control for AmpliHealth (we can't accept language that burns the credit if we acquire a smaller entity).
- SLA credits: we need explicit escalation and remediation hours in the SOW for Priority tier (procurement + legal request wording).

Can you also indicate whether Redwood will accept AmpliHealth's standard PO terms including net-60 payment? If not, what is the max payment term you can accept?

Procurement timeline: target to issue PO by 2026-07-16 if redlines are handled swiftly.

Thanks,
AmpliHealth Procurement
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@amplihealth.com, Claire Beaumont <claire@amplihealth.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-06T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Final commercial framing and SOW deliverables (SLA ladder + credits)

Hi Claire / Procurement —

Thanks for the list — I wanted to step in and consolidate so procurement has a PO-ready packet this week. Our final commercial framing (attached):

- Platform fee: Offer A accepted as anchor — 25% reduction if 12-month commit is signed by July 23, 2026. Fee will be invoiced 50% up front and 50% amortized over remaining term if elected.
- Migration credit: $75,000 invoice credit applied within 90 days of SOW signature. Credit is transferable to AmpliHealth over corporate changes but is void if the contract is terminated for cause. We'll include transfer language in the SOW.
- Payment terms: Redwood standard is net-30; we can agree to net-45 for this deal as a concession. Net-60 will require finance approval and a minor discount impact — please indicate if net-60 is an absolute requirement.
- SLA ladder (summary): Priority — 99.5% monthly availability target; 0.5% invoice credit per missed SLO up to 5% cap; includes 8 remediation hours per quarter. Premier — 99.9% target; 1% cap; includes a dedicated remediation window and 24 SRE hours annually. Full SOW has exact definitions and measurement windows.

Attached: SOW_AmpliHealth_v3.docx (PO-ready with redline placeholders), pricing_spreadsheet.xlsx (amortization and invoice rows).

Next actions:
1) Procurement: confirm whether net-60 is required or if net-45 works; provide vendor fields (tax id, remittance address).
2) Legal: if you have standard redlines, please send a consolidated list — we will convert any commercial asks that impact pricing into tracked concessions in the SOW.

Ben / Marissa: please hold the Offer A anchor live until COB 2026-07-23 per Claire's timeline.

Irene Choi
Head of Solution Pricing, Redwood Inference
